parts.tooltip: fmap f :: Prob a ⟶ Prob (Prob b)\n[(a, pa)]  →  [(f a, pa)]\nEach outcome a keeps its probability pa and is replaced by the distribution f a.

join :: Prob (Prob b) ⟶ Prob b — the Prob-specific part\n[(b, pa*pb) | (dist, pa) <- outer, (b, pb) <- dist]\nEach inner outcome is weighted by the probability of its branch — law of total probability.

ports.tooltip: Prob a = [(a, p)] — each possible outcome a paired with its probability p. Probabilities sum to 1.
f : a ⟶ Prob b — user code; conditional distribution: given outcome a, returns a distribution over b
Prob b — the marginal distribution over b, weighting each branch by the probability of reaching it; never Prob (Prob b)
